svg.title: How your Research Methods grade works

cc:Work.dc:title: How your Research Methods grade works
cc:Work.dc:description: Programming 67% and writing 33%. Exercise 1: 10% submission plus 15% individual test. Exercise 2: 10% submission plus 15% individual test. Final practical: 17%. Pass requires at least 50/100 overall and 23.5/47 across the individual tests and practical combined.
